description: Return all memories currently in the focus buffer (0-3) with full content
embedding_description: READ-ONLY enumeration of all memories pinned in the actr_memory focus buffer. Returns full memory content per pinned item (memory_id guaranteed). Use as working-memory diagnostic to see what content the system is currently injecting into every prompt before adding/removing pins. EDGE verb. Sibling to focus (add) and unfocus_action (remove).
